answer.camera_language: Eye-level shared frames and measured approaches build connection; the father's demand peaks in an elevated push toward Anudi, before widening farewells and a retreating exit.
answer.arc: Gratitude and curiosity at 1–2 rise to admiration at 3, quiet briefly before the call, tighten through 4 to 5 under family pressure, then recede through 4–3 to reflective distance at 2.

clips.direction: toward the space between both faces
clips.trigger: The phone passes to Anudi and she begins her thanks.
clips.motivation: Draw the practical exchange into a warmer shared frame without privileging either person.
clips.opens_on: A waist-up two-shot, Anudi left and Kasun right, with the offered phone between them.

clips.composition_note: Balance both faces across the central phone; settle before her gratitude finishes.
clips.why: Intimacy 2: a slow shared approach makes her gratitude reciprocal, then settles without exaggerating the handover.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up two-shot, push slowly closer as the phone passes between them, then settle with both framed lower-chest up and the phone near the bottom edge.

clips.trigger: The phone passes between their hands.

clips.composition_note: Leave enough room left for the phone's short withdrawal without correcting the frame.
clips.why: Intimacy 2: stillness lets the phone bridge their hands and establishes the visual rhyme with the later caller display.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a slightly downward waist-height insert on the phone between their hands, ending with the handset toward the left of the unchanged frame.

clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium close-up, push slowly toward Kasun through his reply, ending shoulders up on the right third with looking room left.

clips.trigger: Anudi smiles toward the business before L4.

clips.trigger: Anudi's preceding glance and question direct attention toward the business.

clips.camera_sentence: From Anudi's eye level, pan slowly right across the medium view of the food three-wheeler, ending with its working frontage centered behind its soft near edge.

clips.direction: toward the space between both faces

clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly high three-quarter medium close-up, push slowly toward Anudi as her gaze settles, then stop on her face and phone beneath the umbrella edge.

clips.camera_sentence: Hold the eye-level close-up as Anudi's smile fades and she answers, ending on her subdued face beside the phone.
